fill.algorithm: priority flood, 4 face neighbours; all OSM water pixels and external edge are seeds; no artificial epsilon slope
fill.review_threshold: max fill > 1 m OR area > 1000 m2; flags do not prove error

buildings.method: DSM pixels only inside OSM building polygons, max with filled DTM; native roof variability retained; water wins on overlaps
buildings.height_statistics: median and p90 absolute roof; p90 DSM minus filled ground, sampling 1 m eroded interiors if >=10 pixels
buildings.subpixel_policy: 17 footprints contain no 1 m cell centres: height stats use all intersecting pixels and are flagged subpixel; geometry kept in SHP, absent from centre-rasterized obstacles

lakes.name: Serpentine
lakes.depth_source: UKCEH 42218 mean depth; uniform trial bed, no surveyed spatial bathymetry
lakes.stage_source: EA DTM interior water-surface median, rounded to 0.01 m; trial stage, not a gauge observation

lakes.name: Long Water
lakes.depth_source: UKCEH 42218 mean depth; uniform trial bed, no surveyed spatial bathymetry
lakes.stage_source: EA DTM interior water-surface median, rounded to 0.01 m; trial stage, not a gauge observation

lakes.name: Round Pond
lakes.depth_source: ASSUMED 0.5 m trial depth; no verified public depth found
lakes.stage_source: EA DTM interior water-surface median, rounded to 0.01 m; trial stage, not a gauge observation

limitations: Full land depression filling may remove real basements, underpasses and storage. Flagged cells are not verified errors.
OSM snapshot is not a completeness guarantee; footprints are contemporary whereas EA composite is 2022 and may contain surveys from differing dates.
DSM inside footprints can contain tree overhang, rooftop objects or low returns; building stats are unverified estimates.
No drainage, infiltration, roof runoff routing, underground lake pipes, pump flows or penstock model.
Trial lake beds are uniform mean-depth assumptions. DTM median stages are not gauge readings.
UKCEH coarse elevation 17 m AOD is not adopted; local DTM water surfaces near 15 m ODN set trial stage.
DSM_final is a synthetic hydraulic DEM, not a measured DSM or a digital twin mesh.
